correctness.rationale: For 2x2x2 unimodular Fourier cube coefficients, gauge-normalize four vertices to 1 and label remaining (A,B,C,D). The full 27-term convolution identity gives M=88+2 sum of four explicitly listed squared correlations; Newton inequality yields exactly three isolated continuous minima M=88. The local phase Hessian at each is G=diag(8,8,8,8) with -4 D-cross entries; eigenvalues 8,8,8±4sqrt(3) are strictly positive. For odd q write theta=pi/q and near sign pattern use even/odd parity lattice v; v_D=2m, Q=8[(v_A-m)^2+(v_B-m)^2+(v_C-m)^2+m^2] has exactly 8 minimal vectors of value 16 near each of 3 minima, next value >=48. All 24 have exact Laurent-substitution value 136-64cos(theta)+16cos²(theta). Compactness plus strict Hessian makes every large-odd-q global minimizer an O(1/q) lattice perturbation, so gap forces exactly 24 normalized minimizers, 24q^4 lifts; q²(M-88)->16pi². Independently enumerated all q^4 normalized configurations q=5,7 and confirmed 24 minimizers with exact candidate value; finite q does not prove eventual all q.
